title: Black Hole Response Theory and its Exact Shockwave Limit
summary: We present a black hole response formalism formulated within the worldline approach to the classical gravitational two-body problem. The central objects are response functions: a hierarchy of correlators that encode, successively, the black hole's own gravitational field, the scattering of a gravitational wave off of the black-hole including recoil, and the nonlinear response to multiple gravitational perturbations.
